name: Tom Segura
blurb: Deadpan confessional storyteller: family, the body, and the things you are not supposed to admit.
bio: Tom Segura is an American stand-up comedian, writer, director, and podcaster whose deadpan, confessional storytelling is built out of his family, his body, and the admissions most people work to avoid. Born in Cincinnati in 1979 to a Peruvian mother, he grew up speaking Spanish and spending summers in Lima, and started stand-up after graduating from Lenoir-Rhyne University. He broke through on Netflix with Completely Normal in 2014 and has released a special roughly every two or three years since, through Mostly Stories, Disgraceful, Ball Hog, Sledgehammer, and Teacher at the end of 2025. Away from the stage he co-hosts Your Mom's House with Christina Pazsitzky and 2 Bears, 1 Cave with Bert Kreischer, the two anchors of YMH Studios, the podcast network the pair built out of a show they started in a spare room in 2010. His 2022 essay collection I'd Like to Play Alone, Please reached No. 2 on the New York Times hardcover nonfiction list, and in 2025 he created, wrote, directed, and starred in Bad Thoughts, a Netflix sketch anthology that earned him an Emmy nomination in each of its first two years.
